# Land Use / Land Cover {#sec-LULC}  

```{r}
library(msepBaselineData)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(reactable)
```

```{r}
# render tables interactively or statically
out_format <- knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to")

# if it's an interactive session, out_format will be NULL from the above command, so do things the html way
if (is.null(out_format)) {
  out_format <- "html"
}
```


## Overall Summary  

**Note: These summaries are NOT factual.** They are examples of how we might want to talk about what we find, to help ensure we do calculations in the right way. I am completely making up details and could be very, very wrong. Please do not treat this information as factual.    


e.g. "The coastal counties of the watershed have become more developed in the last 10 years, while developed landcover in the more inland counties has remained relatively stable"  


## Supporting Information  

Data for this section comes from the National Land Cover Dataset, Collection 1.2, as processed into the [`{msepBaselineData}`](https://github.com/CMEP-MS/msepBaselineData) R package.

### Entire Watershed  

```{r}
lulc_watershed_table <- lulc_yearly_watershed |> 
  summarize(.by = c(year, lulc_broad),
            pixels = sum(pixel_count),
            area_sqkm = sum(area_sqkm),
            area_acres = sum(area_acres)) |> 
  mutate(.by = year,
         pct_cover = round(pixels / sum(pixels) * 100, 1))

summary_wide_watershed <- lulc_watershed_table |> 
  arrange(year) |> 
  select(Category = lulc_broad, 
         year, pct_cover) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = pct_cover,
              values_fill = 0)
  
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-lulcWatershed
#| tbl-cap: "Percent land cover across the entire Mississippi Sound Watershed by year and broad land cover category."

if (out_format == "html") {
  #### reactable version
  
  reactable(summary_wide_watershed,
            striped = TRUE,
            sortable = TRUE,
            defaultPageSize = 20,
            defaultColDef = colDef(align = "right",
                                   format = colFormat(digits = 1,
                                                      suffix = "%")),
            columns = list(Category = colDef(align = "left",
                                             format = colFormat())))
  
} else {
  #### static knitr::kable version (PDF)
  
  n_years <- ncol(summary_wide_watershed) - 1
  
  summary_wide_watershed |> 
    mutate(across(-Category, ~ scales::percent(.x,
                                               scale = 1,
                                               accuracy = 0.1))) |> 
    knitr::kable(align = paste0("l", strrep("r", n_years)))
}
```


### By Basin  

```{r}
lulc_basin_table <- lulc_yearly_basin |> 
  summarize(.by = c(year, basin_name, lulc_broad),
            pixels = sum(pixel_count),
            area_sqkm = sum(area_sqkm),
            area_acres = sum(area_acres)) |> 
  mutate(.by = c(year, basin_name),
         pct_cover = round(pixels / sum(pixels) * 100, 1))

summary_wide_basin <- lulc_basin_table |> 
  arrange(basin_name, year) |> 
  select(Basin = basin_name, 
         Category = lulc_broad, 
         year, pct_cover) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = pct_cover,
              values_fill = 0)
  
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-lulcBasin
#| tbl-cap: "Percent land cover by basin, year, and broad land cover category. In the html version, click on a Basin to expand it to the categories."

if (out_format == "html") {
  #### reactable version
  
  reactable(summary_wide_basin,
            striped = TRUE,
            sortable = TRUE,
            groupBy = "Basin",
            defaultExpanded = FALSE,
            defaultPageSize = 25,
            defaultColDef = colDef(align = "right",
                                   format = colFormat(digits = 1,
                                                      suffix = "%")),
            columns = list(Basin = colDef(align = "left",
                                          format = colFormat(),
                                          style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
                           Category = colDef(align = "left",
                                             format = colFormat())))
  
} else {
  #### static knitr::kable version (PDF)
  
  n_years <- ncol(summary_wide_basin) - 2
  
  summary_wide_basin |> 
    mutate(across(-c(Basin, Category), ~ scales::percent(.x,
                                                         scale = 1,
                                                         accuracy = 0.1))) |> 
    knitr::kable(align = paste0("ll", strrep("r", n_years)))
}
```
